long_biography.plain_text:
Rinaldi began at Exxon and left in 1980 to co-found Phibro Resources, an energy and natural-resources development business. He later helped expand Tosco before assembling a record of acquiring complex industrial assets and leading them through operational turnarounds.

At Coffeyville Resources, he combined a refinery with a nitrogen-fertilizer operation, then sold the developed business to new financial owners. He applied the same acquisition-led model in Philadelphia, partnering with Carlyle to form Philadelphia Energy Solutions around two former Sunoco refineries. Rinaldi subsequently promoted a broader regional energy hub and, after retiring, returned with a proposal to restart the refinery complex.
